response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE t.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS second_avg FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - o.overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall, AVG(k.avg_pulse_rate - s.second_avg) AS mean_above_second FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN overall AS o CROSS JOIN second_average AS s WHERE k.avg_pulse_rate > s.second_avg;
